name: LEADsms
description: Support visitors and generate leads via SMS/text messaging.
project_description:
LEADsms enables Drupal webmasters to engage with site visitors via SMS, generating leads and offering support directly through text messaging. It integrates with the CONNECTsms platform for seamless communication with users.

 Features 
 LEADsms allows site owners to connect their Drupal site with the CONNECTsms platform via a web widget. The module collects user input through a form and sends the message content and phone number securely to the CONNECTsms account, where users can engage with visitors via SMS. The module is ideal for businesses wanting to offer quick, convenient support or generate leads through a personal communication channel.

 Key features include: 

 
 Seamless integration with the CONNECTsms platform. 
 Real-time engagement with site visitors through SMS. 
 Lead generation and customer support via text messaging. 
 
 This module is perfect for businesses or websites that want to enhance user engagement, provide customer support, or generate leads using SMS.

 Post-Installation 
 After installing LEADsms, users should configure the module by entering their CONNECTsms activation key. This can be done through the configuration page found at /admin/config/leadsms_text/settings . Once configured, the LEADsms widget will be available on the site, ready to accept user input and send SMS messages.

 Additional Requirements 
 
 CONNECTsms subscription : A valid subscription is required to use the module. 
 PHP 8.0 or higher : Required for Drupal 10 and 11. 
 
 Supporting this Module 
 To support ongoing development of this module, please consider subscribing to CONNECTsms.
